services.name: Glow Express Facial
services.description: A 30-minute facial designed for customers who want a quick refresh during lunch or before an event. Includes cleansing, exfoliation, hydration, and finishing serum.

services.name: Signature Radiance Facial
services.description: A 60-minute facial focused on hydration, dullness, and overall skin glow. Includes double cleanse, exfoliation, mask, face massage, serum, and moisturizer.

services.name: Deep Renewal Facial
services.description: A 75-minute treatment for customers looking for deeper exfoliation and skin renewal. Includes customized masks and extended massage.

services.name: Calming Sensitive Skin Facial
services.description: A gentle facial for customers with easily irritated skin. Focuses on soothing products and barrier support.

services.name: Brightening Vitamin C Facial
services.description: A glow-focused facial designed to improve the appearance of dull skin using brightening products and antioxidant support.

services.name: Swedish Massage
services.description: A relaxation-focused massage using long, flowing strokes to reduce stress and muscle tension.

services.name: Deep Tissue Massage
services.description: A firmer pressure massage for customers with chronic tension in areas such as shoulders, neck, and back.

services.name: Aromatherapy Massage
services.description: A calming massage experience that combines relaxation techniques with essential oil blends.

services.name: Prenatal Massage
services.description: A gentle massage for eligible prenatal clients seeking relaxation and physical comfort.

services.name: Detox Body Scrub
services.description: Full-body exfoliation followed by hydration treatment.

services.name: Sea Mineral Body Wrap
services.description: A restorative body treatment intended to leave skin soft and refreshed.

services.name: Kids Mini Facial
services.description: A gentle, fun introduction to skincare for children using mild, age-appropriate products.

services.name: Kids Hand & Foot Treat
services.description: A simple pampering session with light soaking, lotion, and nail shaping.

services.name: Mom & Me Relax Package
services.description: A family-friendly package that includes one Signature Radiance Facial for the adult and one Kids Mini Facial for the child.

services.name: Relax & Glow Package
services.description: Includes one Signature Radiance Facial and one 60-minute Swedish Massage.

services.name: Bridal Glow Prep Package
services.description: Includes one Brightening Vitamin C Facial, one Glow Express Facial, and one eyebrow wax.

services.name: Family Wellness Bundle
services.description: Includes one 60-minute Swedish Massage, one Glow Express Facial, and one Kids Hand & Foot Treat.

offers.name: New Guest Welcome Offer
offers.description: First-time customers receive 15% off one full-priced service from Monday to Thursday. Cannot be combined with other promotional bundles or membership pricing.

offers.name: Spring Reset Facial Month
offers.description: 10% off Glow Express Facial on weekdays during April.
